summary: Describes how Change-of-Authorization and Disconnect messages from RFC 5176 can be proxied in RADIUS when networks use realm-based proxying as defined in RFC 7542. It updates RFC 5176 and also updates RFC 5580 to allow the Operator-Name attribute in CoA-Request packets. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a network needs to tell a user's connection to change or stop, and the message must pass through several middle servers. This document explains how to pass such messages along correctly.
